How I can help

You don't need five vendors. Through me you get Nationwide Haul's full team: sales, financing, insurance and service.

New & used equipment

Trucks and semi-trailers from brands we're authorized to sell, including MAC, Vanguard, Dorsey, Pitts, XL Specialized and Autocar. Stock ready to go in FL & GA.

In-house financing

All credit types welcome, $0 down available, and no hard credit pull to pre-qualify. I'll walk you through it.

Trade-ins & selling

Get fair value for the equipment you're replacing. We buy outright, consign or take it in trade.
